xwikidoc.content: {{include reference="XWiki.LiveTableResultsMacros" /}} {{velocity wiki="false"}} ## Same results as XWiki.LiveTableResults for the external users and their mapping, except that: ## * the login of a GitHub user is displayed as a link to their GitHub profile ## * the number of advisories without assignee each external user is involved in is computed #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' and "$!request.outputSyntax" == 'plain') #set ($map = {}) #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON("$!request.classname" $request.collist.split(',') '' '' {} $map) #foreach ($row in $map.rows) #set ($externalUserObject = $xwiki.getDocument($row.doc_fullName).getObject($request.classname)) #set ($hint = "$!externalUserObject.getValue('hint')") #set ($escapedLogin = $escapetool.xml($externalUserObject.getValue('login'))) #if ($hint == 'github') #set ($discard = $row.put('login', "@$escapedLogin")) #else #set ($discard = $row.put('login', $escapedLogin)) #end #set ($count = $services.securityadvisory.countUnassignedAdvisories($hint, $externalUserObject.getValue('externalId'))) #set ($discard = $row.put('unassignedAdvisories', "$!count")) #end #jsonResponse($map) #end {{/velocity}}
